tables.name: Dimension Selector

measures.name: Sales Share of Category
measures.dax: DIVIDE([Total Sales], CALCULATE([Total Sales], ALL(Product), VALUES('Product Category'[Category])))

measures.name: New Customers
measures.dax: CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT(Customer[CustomerKey]), FILTER(Customer, Customer[Signup Date] >= MIN(Date[Date]) && Customer[Signup Date] <= MAX(Date[Date])))

measures.name: Stock Cover Days
measures.dax: DIVIDE([Units On Hand], DIVIDE([Units Sold], COUNTROWS(VALUES(Date[Date]))))

tables.name: Metric Selector

nodes.name: Environment
nodes.code: "Production" meta [IsParameterQuery=true, Type="Text", IsParameterQueryRequired=true]

nodes.name: ServerName
nodes.code: "adb-contoso.azuredatabricks.net" meta [IsParameterQuery=true, Type="Text", IsParameterQueryRequired=true]

nodes.name: StartYear
nodes.code: 2019 meta [IsParameterQuery=true, Type="Number", IsParameterQueryRequired=true]

nodes.name: fnCleanText
nodes.code: (value as text) as text => Text.Trim(Text.Clean(value))

nodes.name: RawSales
nodes.code:
let
    Source = Databricks.Catalogs(ServerName, "/sql/1.0/warehouses/demo", []),
    db = Source{[Name="sales",Kind="Schema"]}[Data],
    tbl = db{[Name="fact_sales",Kind="Table"]}[Data]
in
    tbl

nodes.name: StageSales
nodes.code:
let
    Source = RawSales,
    // The synthetic source has order_date; Environment gates production rows.
    Filtered = Table.SelectRows(Source, each Environment = "Production" and Date.Year([order_date]) >= StartYear)
in
    Filtered
